name: Adobe Express
tagline: Template-based quick editor for social graphics, videos, PDFs, and assets

pricing.notes: Official pricing URL checked; 2026 public coverage lists Premium at $9.99/month or $99.99/year.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.limits: 5 GB storage; 1 social account per network; 10-day version history; video up to 30 minutes; 10 PDF quick actions/month; 5 lifetime presentation generations; 2 lifetime 5-second video generations.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.limits: 250 generative credits/month; 3 social accounts per network; 30-day history; video up to 2 hours.
tiers.notes: The live Adobe materials checked did not expose a separate annual-effective USD rate for this standalone plan.

tiers.name: Teams
tiers.limits: 250 generative credits/user/month and 1 TB storage/user; minimum 2 seats.
tiers.notes: Annual-effective value is $49.99 per person per year divided by 12.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.limits: Custom seats, storage, security and support; public price is not listed.

pricing.freeTierCaps: 5 GB storage, 1 social account per network, 10-day history, 10 PDF quick actions/month, 5 lifetime presentation generations and 2 lifetime 5-second video generations.
pricing.billingTerms: Premium is sold monthly; Teams is sold monthly and annually, with a 2-seat minimum
pricing.hiddenCosts: Teams requires at least 2 paid seats. Generative-credit limits apply, premium stock/assets can require a paid entitlement, and taxes may be added. Firefly Pro at $19.99/month is a separate bundle that includes Express Premium.

verdictSummary: You can build a quick image editor and template exporter, but Adobe's stock/licensing, PDF/media tooling, brand assets, and Creative Cloud tie-ins are the product.
coreLoopDIY: Build a small template editor for images/videos with text overlays, background removal via API, and export.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because the content and export ecosystem is already there.

priorArt.name: GrapesJS
priorArt.desc: Open-source visual builder useful for layout/template-editor concepts, though not a full E

alternatives.name: Adobe Express Free
alternatives.desc: The zero-dollar plan still makes and exports social posts, short videos, and PDFs; bulk resize and proper brand kits remain rent.

facts.install: Hosted signup in a browser, or install the Adobe Express desktop/mobile app.
facts.engines: Adobe Firefly models power the generative features.
facts.dataFormat: Projects, uploads, libraries and brand assets live in Adobe's cloud; exports include image, PDF and video files.
facts.gapVsPaid: The free tier withholds premium templates and stock, advanced Brand Kits and one-click bulk resizing that make paid Adobe Express convenient.

alternatives.name: Canva Free
alternatives.desc: The bigger template pantry for graphics, clips, docs, and decks, minus Magic Resize and the grown-up brand controls.

facts.install: Hosted signup in a browser, or install Canva's desktop/mobile app.
facts.engines: Canva AI and Magic Studio provide generative tools; Canva does not publish a complete provider/model map for the free editor.
facts.dataFormat: Designs, uploads, folders and brand assets live in Canva's cloud; users export common image, PDF, presentation and video formats.
facts.gapVsPaid: Canva Free lacks Adobe's Firefly and Creative Cloud integration and also paywalls one-click resizing and advanced brand controls.

alternatives.name: Desygner Free
alternatives.desc: Templates, basic photo work, PDFs, scheduling, and simple brand assets for three people without a countdown clock.

facts.install: Hosted signup in a browser, or install the mobile app.
facts.engines: Desygner's terms identify OpenAI-backed AI features.
facts.dataFormat: Projects, uploads, fonts and brand assets live in Desygner's cloud; designs export as image or PDF files.
facts.gapVsPaid: Desygner's editor, motion tools and content library are less polished and extensive than paid Adobe Express.

alternatives.name: VistaCreate Starter
alternatives.desc: Quick social graphics, animation, scheduling, one brand kit, and unlimited exports; the one-click Resizer is paid.

facts.install: Hosted signup in a browser, or install the mobile app.
facts.dataFormat: Projects, uploads and the single Brand Kit live in VistaCreate's cloud; exports include image, GIF and video files.
facts.gapVsPaid: VistaCreate Starter is weaker for PDFs, documents and general-purpose video editing than paid Adobe Express.

notes: Useful contrast with Canva: same template moat, different ecosystem.
prompt:
Build me a social graphics generator to replace Adobe Express. Requirements:

- A local web app: Node + Express, templates are plain HTML/CSS files in
  templates/, rendered to PNG by a headless Playwright screenshot at exact
  pixel sizes. No frontend framework.
- Ship 5 starter templates: Instagram square 1080x1080, story 1080x1920,
  X post 1600x900, YouTube thumbnail 1280x720, and a quote card.
- The page shows a template picker, one input per text field, an image drop
  zone, and an accent color picker, with a live preview iframe rendering the
  same template HTML.
- Background removal for uploaded photos via rembg running locally, no paid
  key needed.
- Brand lives in brand.json: two font files in fonts/, 4 hex colors, a logo
  path; every template reads from it.
- Exports save to ~/Graphics/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.png plus a JSON sidecar of the
  field values so any graphic can be re-rendered later.
- Localhost only, no accounts, no telemetry, my photos never leave the machine.
- Out of scope: video, PDFs, and stock assets. Adobe's licensed library is
  the product, I bring my own images.
- README: setup, installing rembg, and how to add a new template.
